 PDT 80
 Precision Drop Tester
Our most popular precision drop tester, with handheld controller and electric hoist for drop testing of specimen of upto 177 lbs (80 kgs) from heights of 1-192 in (2.5-488 cm).
The PDT 80 is easy to use and can be used for a wide variety of drop testing requirements, including flat, edge and corner drop tests. With a drop height range from as low as 1 in (2.5 cm) to 192 in (488 cm), plus optional test fixtures and flexible base plate choices, it is a versatile and very popular precision drop tester.
Straightforward and intuitive controls enable operators to easily adjust drop heights and reset the platform, enabling safe and efficient testing. The PDT 80 delivers precision and repeatability, saving time and manual effort.
Lansmont also offer test fixtures, extended platen, slotted and oversized base plates, as well as customised test heights to meet your precise testing requirements.

PDT80 overview
The Lansmont PDT 80 is our most popular model of drop tester and used for a wide range of drop testing requirements.
Its high-velocity pneumatic cylinder, precision cam design and unique braking system delivers extremely accurate flat drop testing exceeding key industry standards, such as ASTM D5276.
We test and verify every drop tester to ensure its flatness accuracy is within ±2 degrees.
Drop platform
The drop platform, also known as a 'drop leaf', is where the product or package to be tested is placed.
Specimen weight/payload
Standard - 177 lbs (80 kg) max
Extended - 150 lbs (68 kg) max
Specimen depth (front-to-back)
Standard - 24 in (61 cm)
Extended - 36 (91.5 cm)
Specimen can be placed flat or positioned using optional edge and corner fixtures, to hold the item at specified orientations for different impact scenarios.
Hoist
The electric hoist provides precise drop height adjustment, enabling you to set and adjust the height from which the item will be dropped, from 1 in (2.5 cm) up to 192 in (488 cm), allowing for different impact scenarios.
Drop height range(s)
Standard drop platform platen
Slotted baseplate: 1 - 192 in (2.5 - 488 cm)
Standard baseplate: 12 - 192 in (30.5 - 488 cm)
Extended drop platform platen
For accommodating larger package sizes of up to 36 in (91.5 cm) in depth (front-to-back).
Extended platen: 18 - 192 in (45.7 - 488 cm)
Customisation
Some goods require more severe drop tests during certification testing. We can deliver extended or bespoke height drop testers to satisfy your precise testing requirements and environment.
Controller
Handheld controller
The PDT's handheld controller is a plug-and-play device with a straightforward setup and calibration routine.
The controller's digital display simultaneously indicates current and desired drop height settings, with simple controls for setting the required drop height and starting a test.
Foot switch
Actuation of the drop and resetting of the drop platform can also be operated using a separate foot switch, for greater safety and efficiency.
Base plate
The base platform provides the basic impact surface when drop testing and base plate fixtures can be used for testing different impact scenarios.
Slotted base plates
Customers requiring drop heights below 12 in (< 30.5 cm) have the option of a 'slotted' base plate and foundation kit, enabling drop tests from as low as 1 in (2.5 cm).
Oversized base plates
Larger packages can require a larger impact surface. We can provide 'oversized' base plates that increases the impact area from 36 in (91.4 cm) up to 60 in (152.4 cm)
Key specifications
The standard range for the PDT 80 makes it ideal for flat drop, edge drop and corner drop testing from individual components to complete products and packages. 
We can also provide extended drop heights that are customised to your testing requirements and environment.
Our expert technical sales team will discuss your requirements and can advise on the testing solution that best meets your business need.
